// RSQ Miniboss options (MENU_STANDARD.md, owner 11-24): Brutal Doom 22's style. The front page holds only the choices a
// player makes, On/Off, short labels, no prose; its one sub menu, "Test and Debug", holds everything else (the numbers,
// the niche rules, Mikk-'s Champions rows, folded in from their own pages, and the logs). Every cvar keeps its row.
// Each row has a tip comment saying what it does; CVARINFO.txt says more. MENUDEF.ldlite (Yholl's LegenDoom Lite,
// generated by tools/gen_ldlite.py) keeps its own menu.

// ---- Radiant Silvergun Options (tools/rsmenu) ----------------------------------------------------
// The series' one Options entry. Every series pk3 carries this same block with its own prefix: the
// parent is PROTECTED, so the first definition stays and later ones add nothing (QZD 17.3 merges a
// protected option menu instead of replacing it); the link row removes any earlier copy of itself,
// so Options shows one row however many series pk3s load. Each mod then adds its own row only.
OptionMenu "RSQ_RSOptions" protected
{
	Class "RSQMB_RSMenu"
	Title "RADIANT SILVERGUN OPTIONS"
}

AddOptionMenu "OptionsMenu"
{
	RSQMBRSLink "Radiant Silvergun Options", "RSQ_RSOptions"
}

AddOptionMenu "RSQ_RSOptions"
{
	Submenu "RSQ Boss", "RSQMB_Options"
}
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OptionValue "RSQMB_FillFrom"
{
	0, "Score"
	1, "Gun Bonsai"
	2, "Both"
}

OptionValue "RSQMB_BossFx"
{
	1, "Full"
	0, "Light"
}

// THE ARRIVAL (design/BOSS_REWORK.md 2, 2026-11-23): Around You, the new one, first
OptionValue "RSQMB_Arrival"
{
	1, "Around You"
	0, "Classic"
}

// Graves Rise Mode: one per stone or the thrall count per stone, over the whole map or within Graves Radius
OptionValue "RSQMB_GraveMode"
{
	0, "Single Map"
	1, "Single Radius"
	2, "Thralls Map"
	3, "Thralls Radius"
}

// a Boss's big attack: by its kind (a gunner the beam; heavy or no missile the ring; else the fan), or one for all
OptionValue "RSQMB_TellAttack"
{
	0, "By Kind"
	1, "Fan"
	2, "Ring"
	3, "Beam"
}

OptionMenu "RSQMB_Options"
{
	Title "RSQ BOSS"
	// tip: Boss fights: the meter fills and a Boss with its thralls arrives.
	Option "Bosses", "rsqmb_enabled", "OnOff"
	// tip: Use on the gold Start Fight card calls a full meter's Boss in; the watch check does not (off: it only comes by itself).
	Option "Call It In", "rsqmb_bf_callin", "OnOff"
	// tip: A card inside the off-hand wrist, gold when the fight can be called; Use on it calls the fight in (with Call It In on).
	Option "Wrist Card", "rsqmb_wristcard", "OnOff"
	// tip: Light draws fewer of the repeated effect pieces (same art); Full draws every one.
	Option "Boss Effects", "rsqmb_bossfx", "RSQMB_BossFx"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Fight", 1
	// tip: Thralls that come with each Boss.
	Slider "Thralls", "rsqmb_thralls", 1, 8, 1, 0
	// tip: A Boss's lives in all (3: it dies on the third).
	Slider "Lives", "rsqmb_lives", 1, 9, 1, 0
	// tip: Around You lands the thralls at your sides and behind; Classic lands all in front after a charge.
	Option "Arrival", "rsqmb_arrival", "RSQMB_Arrival"
	// tip: Rank (0-100) rises with good play and falls when you struggle and sets the difficulty; off, the Monster Tier stays where you set it.
	Option "Rank Difficulty", "rsqmb_rank_on", "OnOff"
	// tip: The map sets how high Rank can go: Common on the first map up to Red on the second-to-last; your play moves it in the three colours under.
	Option "Rank Ceiling", "rsqmb_rank_ceiling", "OnOff", "rsqmb_rank_on"
	// tip: Your damage goes up this much for each colour the monsters are above Common.
	Slider "Your Damage a Colour", "rsqmb_power_step", 0, 0.3, 0.02, 2
	// tip: A REVENGE or a REVIVE multiplies your damage by this for a few seconds.
	Slider "Comeback Damage", "rsqmb_comeback_mult", 1, 3, 0.1, 1
	// tip: How long the comeback damage lasts, in seconds (0: none).
	Slider "Comeback Seconds", "rsqmb_comeback_secs", 0, 30, 1, 0
	// tip: Every so often a Boss winds up a big attack with weak points; break them all in time for BREAK!.
	Option "Telegraphed Attack", "rsqmb_tell", "OnOff"
	// tip: A melee strike on a staggered thrall or a Boss in BREAK! finishes it for health, armour and Score.
	Option "Melee Finishers", "rsqmb_fin", "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Boss Traits", 1
	// tip: Each Boss (not a Big Boss) comes with one trait, named under its bar.
	Option "Boss Traits", "rsqmb_traits", "OnOff"
	// tip: It casts and green rings mark where its fodder lands; hurt it during the cast and fewer land.
	Option "Summoner", "rsqmb_trait_summoner", "OnOff", "rsqmb_traits"
	// tip: Two stamps and a line on the floor, then it rushes along the line; sidestep it and it is stunned.
	Option "Charger", "rsqmb_trait_charger", "OnOff", "rsqmb_traits"
	// tip: A shell blocks hits from the front; hit it from behind or break the points on the shell's rim.
	Option "Shielded", "rsqmb_trait_shielded", "OnOff", "rsqmb_traits"
	// tip: Each life it loses, it splits into two smaller halves; both must die.
	Option "Splitter", "rsqmb_trait_splitter", "OnOff", "rsqmb_traits"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Big Boss", 1
	// tip: A bar that fills a quarter for every Boss you beat; full, a Big Boss comes.
	Option "Big Boss", "rsqmb_ex", "OnOff"
	// tip: A Boss won drops a kiosk of legendary weapons to buy with gold.
	Option "Boss Kiosk", "rsqmb_kiosk", "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	// tip: Legendary monsters for players without LegenDoom. Stands down by itself while LegenDoom is loaded.
	Submenu "LegenDoom Lite", "RSQMB_LDLite"
	// tip: The meter, arrival, fight, rank, big attack, finisher, Big Boss, kiosk and Champions numbers, and the logs.
	Submenu "Test and Debug", "RSQMB_Test"
	// tip: Puts every RSQ Boss setting back to its default.
	RSQMBResetAll "Reset All", "Reset all RSQ Boss settings?"
}
